::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/templates/{type}/preview"}
#docs
Pass a partial draft to preview unsaved edits; omit the body to preview what is currently in effect.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `type` | `string` | **yes** | Billing email type |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject` | `string` | no | The draft subject line. |
| `heading` | `string` | no | The draft heading. |
| `body` | `string` | no | The draft body text. |
| `footer` | `string` | no | The draft footer text. |
| `cta_label` | `string` | no | The label of the call-to-action button. |
| `show_facts` | `boolean` | no | Whether the email shows the table of key facts. |
| `block_order` | `array of string` | no | Order of the movable sections, each exactly once. Null = body, action, facts, footer. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_preview`. One of `email_preview`. |
| `subject` | `string` | The rendered subject line. |
| `html` | `string` | The rendered HTML body. |
| `text` | `string` | The rendered plain-text body. |
| `customized` | `boolean` | True if the preview uses a template you changed. |
| `issues` | `array of object` | Problems in the draft. Errors would make a save fail; warnings would not. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Rendered |
| `400` | Unknown email type |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/templates/invoice_issued/preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "subject": "Your invoice from Brightwater Analytics",
    "heading": "Thanks for your business"
  }'
```

#response

{
  "object": "email_preview",
  "subject": "Your invoice from Brightwater Analytics",
  "html": "<p>Hello Maya</p>",
  "text": "Hello Maya",
  "customized": false,
  "issues": [
    {
      "field": "subject",
      "severity": "error",
      "message": "Requested by the customer."
    }
  ]
}
```

  "error": {

    "message": "Unknown email type"
  }
}
```
